name: 2026-09-stocks-mean-reversion
hypothesis: RSI mean reversion (35/65) on a 12-ticker equity basket produces a positive per-trade edge that BEATS BUY-AND-HOLD after costs. Prior evidence is inconclusive: pooled out-of-sample mean is +$0.033/trade with a 95% interval of -$0.045 to +$0.111, and walk-forward beat buy-and-hold in only 27 of 60 folds with a mean excess of -0.95%.

success_criteria.note: EFFECTIVE trades, not pooled. The 12 tickers measure as 4.9 independent symbols, so pooled counts overstate evidence ~2.4x.
success_criteria.power_caveat: At the measured per-trade Sharpe of 0.074 a conclusive test needs ~700 independent trades. This run CANNOT confirm a small edge; it can only detect a large one or rule out a disaster.

stopping_rule: Stop at 2026-09-27 OR 20 effective trades, whichever is later. No configuration change before then for any reason short of a bug that stops trades executing. A parameter change restarts the clock and voids this registration.
notes: Crypto is parked: 53 trades, gross +0.794% against a 1.206% fee, and it lost to buy-and-hold on 5 of 7 coins. Its 9 coins measure as 1.4 independent bets.
verdict: VOIDED — not a result. A defect was found in the exit logic four days into the run: the trailing stop armed at +1.0% and exited 1.5% below the peak on a commission-free venue, so any trade peaking between +1.0% and +1.5% closed BELOW entry. The run was measuring a known-broken exit. Superseded by 2026-09-stocks-mean-reversion-v2.
